title: Meal-Status Hardship Terms for Earlier-Year Installment Arrangements, Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program
content:
**Terms.** The hardship terms of a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program installment arrangement add installments according to the status held on the student's active School Nutrition Services Meal Account:

- **2 installments** are added when the active meal account holds a status whose benefit level is free and whose effective date is on or before the day of the payment;
- **1 installment** is added when it holds one whose benefit level is reduced and whose effective date is on or before that day;
- **none** is added otherwise.

The benefit level (paid, reduced or free) and the effective date are those of the status on the student's active meal account at School Nutrition Services.

| Active meal account status | Effective on or before the payment day? | Installments added |
|---|---|---|
| benefit level free | yes | 2 |
| benefit level free | no, it takes effect later | none |
| benefit level reduced | yes | 1 |
| benefit level paid | either | none |
| no active meal account | not applicable | none |
